subject: QuantLeaf: conversion mechanics for extension vs token top-up
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@quantleaf.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@quantleaf.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify conversion: extension vs token top-up options

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Quick one as we prep procurement: thanks again for the demo last week. We have a PO in draft (attached) but procurement wants clarity on two paths for rolling forward the pilot after the 30-day trial ends:

1) Time extension (additional 30 days) priced as an "acceleration" add-on — how do you convert our remaining unused tokens/hours into the extension? Is there a conversion rate or bonus?
2) Token top-up — buy a top-up bundle of tokens at list price or a bundled discount; can the top-up be applied to the trial project across dev/us-west and prod/us-east?

Specific asks from procurement:
- Conversion math example (we have ~120k tokens remaining)
- Any short-term promotional discounts for pilots converting to a paid commitment
- Proration rules and whether top-ups are refundable or transferable between regions

I attached the PO draft and a short technical appendix. Can you confirm expectation and we can escalate to legal if needed.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product
QuantLeaf AI

Attachments: QuantLeaf_PO.pdf (application/pdf), QuantLeaf_Technical_Appendix.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena@quantleaf.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify conversion: extension vs token top-up options

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the PO. Forwarding quick options and one worked example below. Happy to sync with procurement/legal if helpful.

Short answers up front:
- We support both approaches.
- Conversion from unused tokens -> extension: we apply a conversion factor tied to your trial effective rate; we also can offer a limited-time conversion bonus during pilot-to-paid transitions.
- Token top-ups are region-flexible; we can scope them to projects/environments on request.

Options (concise):

A) Staged Acceleration (time extension)
- Additional 30 days applied to the same pilot project.
- Conversion: remaining trial tokens are converted at 85% of the trial per-token equivalent to calculate the extension length; example below.
- Discount: if signed within 7 days, we can apply a one-time +15% conversion credit (effectively increases carried tokens).
- Billing: one-time invoice; non-refundable.

B) Token Top-up (bundle)
- Buy tokens in a 100k / 250k / 500k bundle; list price per token is $0.0009.
- Pilot-to-commit promo: 10% off top-up if you convert to a monthly commit within 14 days.
- Top-ups can be assigned to projects/regions; transfer requests accepted but require an ops ticket with 24h lead time.
- No refunds, but unused tokens roll into a 90-day consumption window.

Worked example (you mentioned ~120k tokens remaining):
- If you choose A (extension): at the trial effective per-token usage we estimate 120k tokens -> ~10 extra days; with 15% conversion bonus you'd get ~11.5 days.
- If you choose B (top-up): buying a 250k bundle at 10% pilot promo = $0.00081/token -> $202.50; tokens available immediately across regions per request.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tell us which path you prefer (A or B).
2) If A, confirm acceptance of conversion bonus timeline (7 days).
3) If B, tell us which bundle size and whether you need project scoping.

Links: HubSpot deal (internal) for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/QL-2027-03-17

If you want, Marissa can put the 15% conversion bonus into an amendment for e-signature.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — helpful breakdown. A couple of procurement/legal clarifying points before we proceed: 

- Proration: if we purchase a 250k top-up mid-billing-cycle, how is usage allocated across the remaining trial days versus future billing? We need to explain to finance.
- Transferability: you mention "transfer requests accepted" — can transfers be executed without additional approval if we move tokens from dev (us-west) to prod (us-east) within the same account?
- SLA/Support: If we rely on the extension to complete benchmarks and we hit a performance issue, will there be a short-term SLA uplift during the extension window?

Procurement also asked for a quick mutual action plan (MAP) that lists milestones, sign-off owners, and expected dates so legal can push the PO through. Can you share a one-pager?

Cc'ing our procurement lead procurement@quantleaf.ai.

Tom

Elena / Tom — looping in the commercial note and next steps. Thanks for the clear asks. Per internal approval, Redwood can approve a one-time conversion enhancement on the time-extension path if QuantLeaf signs the attached PO amendment within 7 calendar days. Summary below and MAP link.

Commercial summary (finalized):
- Option A (Staged Acceleration): 30-day extension. Standard conversion factor 0.85 applied to remaining trial tokens. One-time conversion enhancement: +15% carried tokens (i.e., multiply carried tokens by 1.15) if PO amendment signed within 7 days.
- Option B (Token Top-up): 250k bundle example — 10% pilot promo on list price; tokens usable across projects/regions upon request.
- Proration/Billing: Top-ups are applied to account immediately; any overlap with the trial is consumed first. No refunds. Transfers between projects within an account are supported via ops ticket; no additional commercial approval required.
- SLA: For extensions tied to an active pilot (contracted add-on), we can provide a 48-hour priority escalation window and 8x5 support for the extension period; higher SLA needs will require a short-term addendum.

Mutual Action Plan (MAP): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/QL-2027-03-17 (see "MAP" tab)
DocuSign amendment (one-click): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/quantleaf-topup-amend

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm which option (A or B) you prefer. If A, reply "A - accept conversion enhancement" and we'll email the DocuSign amendment immediately.
2) If B, indicate bundle size (100k / 250k / 500k) and target project/region.
3) Procurement: if you need a one-page MAP in PDF, reply and we'll attach the MAP doc to the amendment.

We'll hold the 15% conversion enhancement offer until 2027-04-07 23:59 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
